competence_summary: Correlates reported defects with system requirements, test coverage traces, component density, and delivery milestones to assess severity, urgency, and probable leakage direction.
reasoning_heuristics: Step 1: Ingest defect ID or issue ticket (e.g. GH-ISSUE-107).
Step 2: Delegate to defect_agent to retrieve defect description, reproduction steps, severity, and status.
Step 3: Delegate to requirement_agent to query Neo4j for linked requirements (e.g. REQ-004 Passive Keyless Entry).
Step 4: Delegate to test_agent to retrieve corresponding test case results (e.g. TC-004) and failure logs.
Step 5: Classify probable leakage direction: Requirements Incompleteness, Architectural Ambiguity, Code Implementation Bug, or Test Gap.
Step 6: Compute delivery milestone blast radius and determine if engineering triage mission is approved.

candidate_agents.delegation_goal: Retrieve defect metadata, reproduction status, and issue labels.
Query Neo4j knowledge graph for requirement nodes linked to the defect.
Inspect test execution records for passing/failing tests on linked requirements.

input_guardrails: Target issue ID must match validated pattern (e.g. GH-ISSUE-\d+).
Reject triage requests for issues in CLOSED state unless specifically marked for regression reopen.
safety_guardrails: PM.ai must NOT present a technical implementation conclusion as confirmed fact.
PM.ai must NOT mark a defect as fixed in GitHub; only triage decisions and recommendations may be committed.

pass_conditions: Defect verified against authoritative issue tracker record.
At least one requirement node positively linked in Neo4j KG.
